statements.statement: The paper had an expression of concern about its dose-response calculation.
It was then retracted and replaced by a corrected version.
The only change is the Table 3 slope, from 0.45 (CI 0.30 to 0.60) to 0.28 (CI 0.15 to 0.41) points per 10 mg of iron.
The direction of the finding, that more iron gives a larger fatigue reduction, is unchanged.
The draft cites Park and Singh [7] once, in the Discussion.
The draft compares its own slope (0.41 per 10 mg) with Park and Singh's 0.45.
The draft uses that comparison to say the similarity supports its design.
The 0.45 figure is the value the retraction corrected to 0.28 (CI 0.15 to 0.41).
The agreement claim no longer holds.
The draft's 0.41 now sits at the top of the corrected interval.
The comparison use has medium severity, so the impact is low.
0.41 is no longer close to Park and Singh's value.
